extracted.name: Easy Mexican Pizza
extracted.description: Our easy Taco Bell Mexican Pizza copycat recipe tastes better and is healthier than the ones from the drive thru. They have all the good stuff including taco meat, refried beans, and melted cheese inside crispy corn tortillas.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups refried beans ((260g), (or 16 oz can refried beans))
1 1/4 cups red enchilada sauce ((240g), (or a 10oz can red enchilada sauce))
instruction_lines: Cook ground beef, crumbling it into small pieces with a wooden spoon as it cooks. Remove any grease. Add taco seasoning and water and stir to combine.

Crisp tortillas: Heat oil in a small skillet over medium-high heat. Once hot, cook corn tortillas one at a time until golden and slightly crisp on both sides, flipping half way through. Remove to a paper towel.

Assemble: Spoon a thin layer of enchilada sauce on top of one corn tortilla. Spread a layer of refried beans, then spoonful of taco meat. Sprinkle cheese, then place a second corn tortilla on top. Spread with another spoonful of enchilada sauce and cheese.
Bake at 400 degrees F for about 10 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with olives, tomatoes, green onion and sour cream. Cut into wedges to serve.
categories: Mexican pizza recipes with corn tortillas
